summary: Phase 1 (4-tier ARIA plan + feature gating + Upgrade modal + new pages + 25-lead seeder) verified end-to-end. Backend 18/19 pytests passed (1 skipped — Stripe checkout requires real key). Frontend: all new pages render with required data-testids; UpgradeModal flow (open → submit → success → done) works against real /api/billing/request-upgrade; 8 ai-tiles + 8 lock-badges visible on Starter; 11 integration cards; 4 follow-up buckets; 4 plan cards + feature matrix on /billing. Two issues found: (1) Sidebar testid for Plan & Billing is `nav-plan-&-billing` (literal &) instead of expected `nav-plan-billing`; (2) Hydration warning '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>' on /billing plan cards. Final state: workspace plan reset to 'starter'.

minor.issue: With plan_id='pro' returned non-200 in test env (Stripe key likely placeholder). Test marked as skipped. Spec calls for Stripe URL — verify in production with real key.

Always returns requested:true even when Resend send fails (caught + logged). This is intentional for UX but means callers cannot distinguish 'email queued' vs 'email failed'. Consider adding email_sent boolean in response.
feature_keys returned 50 keys (matches spec). All 4 plans (starter, growth, pro, custom) present with correct amount/contact_sales flags.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid for Plan & Billing is `nav-plan-&-billing` (because regex only replaces whitespace, '&' is kept). Spec/test expected `nav-plan-billing`. Fix: change Layout.js:47 regex to /[^a-z0-9]+/g to strip non-alphanumerics. All other 8 nav testids match spec.

ui_bugs.component: Billing plan cards (likely Pro 'Most Popular' card)
ui_bugs.issue: React hydration error: '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>'. Inspect Pro plan-card and headline-features renderer in /app/frontend/src/pages/Billing.js — there's a button wrapping another button.

action_items: Fix Layout.js sidebar testid for 'Plan & Billing': change /\s/g to /[^a-z0-9]+/g so testid becomes 'nav-plan-billing' (drop '&').
Fix nested <button> in Billing.js plan cards (React hydration warning) — likely the Pro card header or feature-row inside the action button.
[Optional] /api/billing/request-upgrade — return email_sent boolean to surface Resend success/failure to caller.
[Optional] Configure live Stripe key so /api/billing/checkout pro path returns a URL instead of skip.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2917 _workspace_plan_id reads workspace_settings_collection on every check — fine for single-tenant MVP but consider caching once multi-tenant.

server.py:2932 require_feature dependency raises 402 with structured detail {code,feature,current_plan,message} — verified importable + correct shape in test_helper_importable. No endpoints currently use it (Phase 2/3 will).
server.py:3069 request_upgrade swallows Resend errors silently and still returns requested:true; activity row is always written. Acceptable for UX, but consider returning email_sent flag.
server.py:4455 /api/admin/load-demo-data uses metadata.demo=true marker for force-reseed — clean. No auth-role guard — any logged-in user can call. Consider admin-only check.
server.py:4502 /api/dev/set-plan correctly admin-only (403 verified for sales rep). Stores plan_id, plan_activated_at, set_by — clean.
Layout.js:47 testid generation uses .replace(/\s/g, '-') which preserves '&' character — produces invalid-looking testid 'nav-plan-&-billing'. Use /[^a-z0-9]+/g instead.
Billing.js — nested <button> is a React + a11y violation. Browser-level click handlers may behave unexpectedly on inner element.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (16/17 testid checks pass; nav-plan-billing testid is incorrectly `nav-plan-&-billing`)

seed_data_creation: Re-seeded 25 demo leads via /api/admin/load-demo-data?force=true. After tests workspace plan reset to 'starter'. 25 demo leads tagged metadata.demo=true remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 backend stable. Plan switching via /api/dev/set-plan?plan_id={starter|growth|pro|custom} works, current-plan reflects within same request, non-admin gets 403. Demo seeder force=true delete+inserts 25 leads with diverse statuses (won/lost/proposal_sent/negotiation present), ICP scores 35-95, deal_value on advanced statuses. Upgrade modal flow tested live: opens with correct featureKey from clicked tile, submitting fires POST /api/billing/request-upgrade and shows success state with `upgrade-modal-done-btn`. /api/leads default page size is 50 — use ?limit=200 to fetch all 25 demo leads when other leads exist (workspace already had ~60 non-demo leads). Two frontend bugs documented for main agent: (a) sidebar testid uses '&' literal — needs regex fix in Layout.js:47, (b) nested <button> in Billing.js plan cards — hydration warning.
rca of the issue: Issue 1 (testid nav-plan-&-billing): Layout.js:47 generates testid via `label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, '-')`. For 'Plan & Billing' this yields 'plan-&-billing' because /\s/g only matches whitespace. Reproduction: open /, inspect sidebar — the Plan & Billing item has data-testid='nav-plan-&-billing'. Fix: replace regex with `/[^a-z0-9]+/g` and trim leading/trailing dashes. Issue 2 (nested button): on /billing the Pro card (Most Popular) renders an outer clickable wrapper plus an inner action <button>. React logs '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>'. Fix: change outer wrapper to a <div> with onClick or remove the wrapper button; inspect Billing.js around plan-card-pro and PRICING_CARDS render.
